title: Potentiometer ADC Mapping Visualizer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Calculate a mapped face-parameter value from a raw ADC reading using the linear mapping formula, and demonstrate how turning a simulated potentiometer knob changes the raw value, the mapped value, and the live arithmetic together.

learningObjectives: Calculate a mapped face-parameter value from a raw ADC reading using the linear mapping formula, and demonstrate how turning a simulated potentiometer knob changes the raw value, the mapped value, and the live arithmetic together.
